name: 近身搏击
description: 选择敌人（1），造成0.75倍伤害。命中后回复1。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 1, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var damage = Math.floor(source.attack * 0.75); var result = dealDamage(source, target, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); if ((result.damage || 0) > 0 && source.currentHp > 0) healDamage(source, source, 1, battle, context.skill.id); return { success: true, message: source.name + '对' + target.name + '造成' + (result.damage || 0) + '点伤害' + ((result.damage || 0) > 0 ? '并回复1点生命' : '') }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece) { return { description: '对1格内敌人造成0.75倍伤害，若命中回复1点生命。', expectedValues: { damage: Math.floor(piece.attack * 0.75), healing: 1 } }; }
